brief.summary: In the week of 2026-08-24, Coinbase, Dexter and Base-chain x402 transactions each fell roughly 78-81% while the Figment facilitator jumped about 303x. In the week of 2026-09-14, Figment reversed (-98%) and PayAI and Solana x402 volume collapsed, taking total x402 transactions down about 90%. None of the provided Hacker News stories explains these shifts, so all eight are low confidence and need a human look, possibly at data quality, bot or spam traffic, or facilitator attribution changes.

inflections.headline: Coinbase facilitator weekly transactions fall ~79% with no identified public trigger

claims.text: Coinbase facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 2304730.0 to 480568.5 (ratio 0.209).
The nearest HN story is a small Show HN about agents paying for data via x402. It coincides in time, but nothing in it explains a drop of this size. Cause is unknown.
claims.quote: Show HN: I built an M2M payment loop where AI Agents pay for data via x402

inflections.headline: Dexter facilitator transactions drop ~81% in same week as Coinbase; no explanation found

claims.text: Dexter facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 26664.0 to 5177.5 (ratio 0.194).

The weekly median after the shift was 5177.5, versus 26664.0 before. The same week saw simultaneous declines in Coinbase and Base series, suggesting a common driver, but none is identified in the sources.

inflections.headline: Figment facilitator surges ~303x from a tiny base, unexplained

claims.text: Figment facilitator weekly median transactions rose from 4862.0 to 1473925.0 (ratio 303.152).

The surge to a weekly median of 1473925 coincides with Coinbase and Base declines the same week, which may indicate traffic being re-attributed or shifted between facilitators. This is a hypothesis, not supported by any source.

inflections.headline: x402 Base-chain transactions fall ~78%, unexplained by available evidence

claims.text: x402 Base weekly median transactions fell from 2412757.0 to 522340.5 (ratio 0.216).
A Show HN for an agent API discovery and payment tool falls near the window but gives no evidence tying it to the Base decline.
claims.quote: Show HN: Orthogonal – One integration for agents to discover and pay for APIs

inflections.headline: Figment facilitator surge unwinds, down ~98% three weeks after it began

claims.text: Figment facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 1473925.0 to 28503.0 (ratio 0.019).
The nearby HN stories concern coding-agent tooling and chat portability, not x402 payments; nothing explains the reversal.
claims.quote: Launch HN: Skillsync (YC W26) – AI chat sessions made portable across agents

inflections.headline: PayAI facilitator transactions collapse ~99% with no identified trigger

claims.text: PayAI facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 4485090.0 to 49368.5 (ratio 0.011).
The window's HN stories are about coding agents and are unrelated to x402 facilitators. Cause is unknown and warrants manual review.
claims.quote: Show HN: Foremerge – Catch intent conflicts between parallel coding agents

inflections.headline: Total x402 transactions fall ~90%, driven by PayAI and Solana declines

claims.text: Total x402 weekly median transactions fell from 7708357.5 to 759455.0 (ratio 0.099).
The drop to a weekly median of 759455 coincides with the PayAI and Solana declines in the same week. No dated public event in the sources explains it.
x402 Solana weekly median transactions fell from 5324299.5 to 130906.0 (ratio 0.025).
The Solana decline coincides with the PayAI decline in the same week (PayAI median after: 49368.5), consistent with PayAI driving much of Solana volume. This is an inference, not sourced.

watchlist: facilitator_figment-facilitator_txs: surged then reversed within three weeks; check for spam or test traffic or attribution changes.
facilitator_payAI_txs and x402_solana_txs: ~99% and ~97.5% drops; confirm whether this is real demand loss or an indexing or data issue.
x402_all_txs: confirm whether the ~90% decline persists or rebounds.
facilitator_coinbase_txs and x402_base_txs: check whether the lower level since 2026-08-24 is stable.
